title: Uploaded evidence appears in review queue with correct control mapping
description: Verifies the full path from file selection through S3 upload, BullMQ processing, to visibility in the review queue.
preconditions: ISO 27001 framework activated for the project
steps: Select a PDF file and map it to control A.8.15
expectedResult: Evidence appears in the review queue with status 'Pending Review', correct file hash, and control mapping A.8.15 visible on the detail page.

title: Approving evidence updates control coverage on the compliance map within the same session
preconditions: An evidence item is in 'Pending Review' status, mapped to a control with 0% prior coverage
steps: Open the pending evidence item as a reviewer
Navigate to /grc-framework/[id]/compliance-map without reloading the browser session
expectedResult: The mapped control now shows non-zero coverage reflecting the newly approved evidence, without requiring a manual refresh trigger.

title: Re-uploading evidence for the same control creates a new version, not a duplicate item
steps: Upload an evidence file mapped to control A.5.3
From the evidence detail page, use 'Upload new version'
expectedResult: The evidence item shows version 2 as current, version 1 remains accessible in version history with its original hash intact.

title: Mapping creator cannot approve/close their own evidence-control mapping
description: Regression guard for the separation-of-duties check now live in updateMappingWorkflowStatus (evidence-mapping.controller.js): if the caller is the mapping's mappedBy and requests status 'closed' or 'not_applicable', the API must return 403. This was previously an open defect (self-review not prevented) and must not regress.
preconditions: User A has both evidence.write and evidence.approve permissions
User A created and mapped an evidence item to control A.5.3 (mappedBy = User A)
steps: As User A, open the mapping just created in Control Mapping
Attempt to change the mapping's workflow status to 'closed' (approve)
Log in as User B (a different reviewer) and repeat the approval
expectedResult: User A's approval attempt is rejected with 403 'You cannot approve your own mapping — a different reviewer must action this.' User B's approval succeeds and creates a WorkflowEntry with status 'closed'.

title: Framework coverage percentage excludes controls marked Not Applicable in the SoA
description: getCoverageStats (evidence-mapping.controller.js) subtracts a ClientFramework's excludedRequirementIds from the denominator when a projectId is supplied. Verifies the fix actually changes the displayed percentage end-to-end, not just the raw formula.
preconditions: A framework with 10 active leaf requirements is attached to a project
2 of the remaining 5 requirements are marked Not Applicable in the project's Statement of Applicability
steps: Navigate to the Control Mapping coverage view for this project/framework
Read the displayed coverage percentage and the covered/total breakdown
expectedResult: Coverage shows 5/8 (62.5%), not 5/10 (50%) — the 2 Not Applicable requirements are removed from both numerator-eligible pool and denominator.
